mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 2% over the last quarter signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of quarters where GDPC1 increased by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% over the last two months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and retail sales by more than 5% each over the last month signals a strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 70% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased by more than 5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over the last month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% over the last two months signals a reduction in inflationary pressures, which eases monetary policy and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% in the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP and retail sales by more than 1% each over the last quarter signals strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both increase > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of quarters where both GDPC1 and RSAFS increased by more than 1%.
